claim_verdicts.evidence: db/pg_hba.conf @ stage-4: "host all all all scram-sha-256". PostgreSQL 17, pg_hba.conf: host "matches connection attempts made using TCP/IP"; database "all specifies that it matches all databases"; user "all ... matches all users"; address "all to match any IP address"; scram-sha-256 "Perform SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication to verify the user's password".
